narrative.scene:
Your team has a working ML service and needs to bring it to more people. Across this volume, you will decide how to prepare its models, share limited infrastructure, keep the service available, and judge whether it should expand. Choose a deployment context. That choice gives the investigations a continuing project, from a fleet of tiny devices with an upstream training service to a cloud recommendation service.

Each lab advances one decision in that story. Here, learn the rhythm: read the situation, predict what will happen, change one condition, inspect the feedback, and explain the tradeoff. The later labs introduce the technical concepts when you need them.
